title: Mother Feeding Baby in High Chair, Kitchen - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid domestic black-and-white snapshot depicting a mother wearing cat-eye style spectacles and a patterned house dress feeding her infant seated in a wooden and metal high chair. A small jar of baby food sits on the kitchen table with a spoon resting inside, highlighting post-war convenience culture in American domestic routines. Decorative plates hang vertically on the wall behind them, epitomizing mid-century suburban home aesthetics.
